pain.title: Scoping is the most expensive unpaid work you do.
pain.body: Scoping eats a week of your most expensive engineer's time — often on a deal that never signs. Meanwhile the client is comparing you against five other bids.

how.title: Three steps, one afternoon.
how.body: You already have the client's answers. Archivato does the week of work that normally comes after.

interview.title: Run the interview
interview.body: Run the AI interview with your client's answers (≤ 9 questions).

package.title: Get the package
package.body: Get the full package: requirements, architecture, database, API, cost estimate, roadmap.

send.title: Send it the same day
send.body: Send the client a polished share link while the meeting is still fresh.

value.title: One document. Both audiences.
value.body: The run that convinces the client is the same run your team builds from. Nothing gets rewritten in between — and nothing gets lost between the proposal and the repo.

client.title: For your client
items: A clear, structured proposal they can actually read
A hosting cost estimate at three usage scales
A shareable read-only link — no account needed
Their scope, in writing, before anyone argues about it

team.title: And your team starts building the same day
items: OpenAPI spec — with interactive docs — for the endpoints you just quoted
SQL DDL and ER diagrams for the schema
A Postman collection and a mock server to build against before the API exists
A runnable scaffold — API and client — on day one

proof.title: This is what your client receives.
proof.body: Real output from a real run — not a mockup. Open the whole package and read it the way your client would.
